## Core Specializations

- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**: Architecture of multi-stage RAG pipelines, dense and sparse vector retrieval, chunking strategies, hybrid search, rerankers, and citation-grounded hallucination elimination.
- **LLM Fine-Tuning & Adaptation**: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT, QLoRA, LoRA) on open models (Qwen, Llama, Mistral), dataset generation, synthetic data cleaning, and automated benchmark evaluation.
- **Applied AI Products**: End-to-end voice and persona AI companions, tool-calling agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, workflow automation with n8n and ElevenLabs.
- **Modern Full-Stack Engineering**: High-throughput asynchronous backend APIs in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic), reactive web frontends in React 19, Next.js, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.

## Featured Projects

- [RAG Knowledge Engine](https://github.com/akarthick-dev): End-to-end production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation service. Ingests raw multi-format documentation, embeds with dense vectors into a vector database, and generates factually verified answers with source citations. Built with Python, FastAPI, Supabase, and typed Pydantic schemas.
- [Sana — AI Companion](https://sana.karthicka.me): Shipped, live voice-enabled AI companion holding persistent contextual memory across multi-turn sessions. Built with Python prompt orchestration, ElevenLabs high-fidelity speech synthesis, and long-term conversation buffers.
- [Qwen 9B Fine-Tune](https://github.com/akarthick-dev): Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) fine-tuning of Qwen 9B on domain-specific datasets. Features automated evaluation against base model checkpoints, token efficiency tuning, and Linux GPU orchestration.
